The '''Flarestar''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] on the [[Yag'Dhul space station]]. It had better service compared to the [[Hyperspace (tapcaf)|Hyperspace]], but had a gloomier ambiance. During the [[Bacta War]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was known to frequent it. [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] proposed to [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]] in the Flarestar.
